record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Let ג(T) denote the family of T-glueable covers: covers that are either multifinite or can be partitioned into finite blocks whose unions form an open τ-cover. Is Ufin(O, T) equivalent to Sfin(Ω, ג(T))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $X$ be an infinite topological space. By a "cover" of $X$ we always mean a collection of open subsets of $X$ none of which equals $X$ itself, whose union is $X$.

- A cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is an $\omega$-cover ($\mathcal{U}\in\Omega$) if every finite subset of $X$ is contained in some member of $\mathcal{U}$.
- A cover $\mathcal{U}$ of $X$ is a $\tau$-cover ($\mathcal{U}\in T$) if it is a large cover (every $x\in X$ belongs to infinitely many $U\in\mathcal{U}$) and for any two points $x,y\in X$, either $\{U\in\mathcal{U}: x\in U,\ y\notin U\}$ is finite, or $\{U\in\mathcal{U}: y\in U,\ x\notin U\}$ is finite.
- A cover $\mathcal{U}$ is multifinite if it can be partitioned into infinitely many finite blocks.
- Let $\gimel(T)$ denote the family of $T$-glueable covers, i.e. open covers $\mathcal{U}$ such that either $\mathcal{U}$ is multifinite, or $\mathcal{U}$ admits a partition into finite blocks $\mathcal{U}=\bigsqcup_{n} F_n$ with $F_n$ finite, such that the collection $\{\bigcup F_n : n\in\mathbb{N}\}$ is an open $\tau$-cover of $X$.

For families $\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B}$ of covers, the selection principles are defined as follows.

- $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B})$: For every sequence $\langle \mathcal{U}_n : n\in\mathbb{N}\rangle$ of members of $\mathscr{A}$, there exist finite sets $F_n\subseteq \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\bigcup_{n}F_n\in\mathscr{B}$.
- $\mathsf{U}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B})$: For every sequence $\langle \mathcal{U}_n : n\in\mathbb{N}\rangle$ of members of $\mathscr{A}$ (with no $\mathcal{U}_n$ containing a finite subcover), there exist finite sets $F_n\subseteq \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\{\bigcup F_n : n\in\mathbb{N}\}\in\mathscr{B}$.

Let $O$ denote the family of all open covers of $X$.

Question. Is it true that, for every (suitable) topological space $X$, the property $\mathsf{U}_{\mathrm{fin}}(O,T)$ is equivalent to $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\Omega,\gimel(T))$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any source confirming a resolution of the equivalence between $\mathsf{U}_{\mathrm{fin}}(O,T)$ and $\mathsf{S}_{\mathrm{fin}}(\Omega,\gimel(T))$. The status appears unverified.

status_evidence.title: On certain star versions of a Ufin-type selection principle
status_evidence.snippet: Studies star variants of Ufin-type selection principles, but does not address the specific equivalence with Sfin(Omega, gimel(T)).
status_evidence.claim: No direct resolution of the question was found in available search results.
